scope: Actual attempt-eight renewal/crash and real expiry, with a committed target/binding generation change after the old process exits. Preserve Rust's stronger generation fence; never mutate running job/lease/clock state or substitute Python's weaker target disable behavior.
generation_change_sql: UPDATE issuance_service.canvas_evidence_sync_targets SET config_version=2,next_run_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '1 day',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id='target-review' AND config_version=1 AND enabled=true
UPDATE issuance_service.canvas_program_bindings SET config_version=2,validated_config_version=2 WHERE id='binding-review' AND config_version=1 AND validated_config_version=1
target_row_sql: SELECT to_jsonb(t) FROM issuance_service.canvas_evidence_sync_targets t WHERE id='target-review'
job_row_sql: SELECT to_jsonb(j) FROM issuance_service.canvas_evidence_sync_jobs j WHERE id='worker-final-job'
